chat.t: Hello, this is Gin.
Forgive me for last night.
Did you have any inconveniences during your stay?
Thanks to you, I believe I had a very special night.
Thank you for your generous understanding despite my lacking hospitality.
I look forward to your next visit.

o: You're the bartender I saw yesterday, right?

chat.t: That is correct.

o: I thought you were an employee from some other place.

chat.t: Another place?

o: Anyway, I'll drop by when I get a chance.

chat.t: Yes.
I will be waiting.

lines.t: That day, I was on my way back after completing a commission in Vermont.
Vermont Alley

It had taken quite some time,
and around the time I was walking through the silent, late-night city...
(I'm tired. Isn't there anywhere to rest?)
Humming?
A low humming sound was leaking out from behind the glass window of a shop.
This place is...
...Hmm?
Ah.
Huh?
My apologies, guest, but...
<Bloody Mary> is closed for the day.
I could have sworn I hung the closed sign at the entrance...
It seems I forgot, however.
I am deeply sorry to have wasted your time.
The sign was hung up just fine.
...Pardon?
I heard singing, so I came in.
I see. So the sound leaked outside.
It was late, so I must have let my guard down without realizing.
How embarrassing. It is not something meant for others to hear...
Well, I thought it was pretty good.
...Is that so?
Thank you for your kind words, despite my lack of skill.
Since you are already here... you are welcome to rest for a moment.
I cannot prepare a drink, but I can at least offer you a seat.
Huh? Is that okay? You said you were closed.
I do not wish to leave a bad impression on a guest who visited <Bloody Mary>.
Besides, you look quite fatigued.
It is no wonder. It seems you have been running around frantically until this late hour.
Heh, how did you know?
I guessed by the lingering scent and the dust on your clothes.
A bartender's job begins with taking an interest in the guest.
...My apologies if I made you uncomfortable.
It's not that, I'm just amazed.
...Thank you for your broad understanding.
You mentioned overtime work, but you need not worry about it.
To be honest, I do not entirely dislike this kind of time.
Welcoming an unexpected guest after hours is... a rare occurrence, after all.
Thanks to that, I seem to have become a bit talkative today.
Does that mean you like surprises?
Rather than liking them...
I do not dislike them' would be more accurate.
The only pity is that there is no drink to grace this moment.
I cannot serve a guest with neither ingredients nor tools prepared.
Failing to serve the perfect drink is a disqualification as a bartender.
So that means...
You'll treat me to the perfect drink next time I come?
Of course. If that is what you wish.
So though it is a pity, please just relax and rest tonight.
And please stop by again when you have the chance next time.
I will be waiting.

chat.t: Hello, this is Gin.
I am contacting you because there is a favor I would like to ask today.
Yes.
Perhaps it would be better to call it a commission.
They say a Job Experience Expo will be held in Vermont soon.
I have been invited to participate as an instructor for the beverage-making workshop.
However, they say the number of applicants is larger than expected.
The expo organizers requested an assistant instructor.
I could not think of anyone else to ask but you.
Of course, I am not asking you to make the drinks.
I will handle everything related to the workshop, so you can think of it as just filling a seat.
Could you help me? I will compensate you handsomely.

o: Well, as long as the pay is solid.
By the way, you do teaching gigs too?

chat.t: To be precise, it is just a one-day gig.
I will explain the details when we meet in person.

lines.t: The next day, I headed to the place Gin told me at the scheduled time.
In Front of Vermont Convention Center
Ah.
Welcome, good morning.
Thank you for coming despite the short notice.
There are so many people.
I heard they rented the entire building for the expo.
This is my first time visiting as well, but it certainly seems highly popular.
This is your first time too?
Yes.
They said the last expo achieved results far exceeding expectations.
So I heard they expanded the scale for this event.
I suppose that is why the offer came to me as well.
Instructor by day, bartender by night. You must be busy.
Opportunities like this do not come around every day.
Besides, the budget seems to have grown along with the scale.
I made sure to secure a proper payment for your participation as assistant instructor.
I'm suddenly feeling highly motivated.
We are scheduled to use the lab on the third floor of the East Wing.
As I mentioned, I will handle all the tedious tasks.
You only need to stay in your spot during the workshop.
Do you have any questions so far?
It's not really important, but...
Is making drinks really that fun?
Pardon?
Since so many people signed up.
And you make them every day anyway, so I was wondering if you ever get bored of it.
I do not believe I have ever found it boring.
Whether it is fun... I am not entirely sure.
I did not start this work for any grand reason or turning point.
I have no ambitious goal like wanting to become a legendary bartender, but...
I still like my current daily life very much.
Serving the ladies, and treating the guests at the bar to drinks.
I only wish for moments like this to continue for as long as possible.
Really? Then that's fine.
...Is that so?
I thought you had something you wanted to know about me.
As long as you're doing what you want, that's what matters.
I was just wondering if that was actually the case.
To hear you say that... makes me very happy.
Well, shall we head inside?
It is time to welcome today's guests.
Workshop Room
...Lastly, gently wipe away any remaining moisture inside the shaker.
If metal tools retain moisture for too long, lingering odors will settle, affecting the next drink you make.
This may sound trivial, but you must have tasted the difference yourself during today's workshop.
Wiping and organizing your tools immediately after use.
I hope you will remember that this is the most important habit for a drinkmaker.
...And with that, we will conclude today's workshop.
Thank you for your hard work, everyone.
Wow...Trainee A
I don't really get it, but that was amazing...Trainee A
Yes, I think I understand what you mean.Trainee B
Being a bartender is actually such a cool job...Trainee B
Thank you for your hard work today.
Turns out you have a talent for teaching too.
You flatter me.
Since it is better to leave a good impression of bartenders if possible.
Even so, demonstrating in front of so many people made me quite nervous.
I am glad you were with me today.
Thinking that I was speaking to you made me feel a bit more at ease.
Well, I'm glad to hear that.
I am glad it was you.
Well, the workshop is over, but...
Would you care to stop by <Bloody Mary> if you do not mind?
A fine bottle came in not too long ago, you see.
Are you planning to bleed me dry already?
...Heh.
It is nothing of the sort.
Today, it is simply my treat.
Consider it a small token of my gratitude.
I don't think I did anything worth thanking.
But hey, if you say so. Let's get going.
Shall we, then?

o: I have a quick favor to ask.

chat.t: Yes.
What is the matter?

o: Come by my office for a bit.
I have something to show you.

chat.t: Understood.
I will visit as soon as I finish my duties.
Thank you for today.
Your drink was not perfect, but that is why it was more meaningful to me.

o: I'm just a beginner, after all.

chat.t: That is true.
Still, I am certain you have talent.
Would you like me to teach you other recipes next time if you do not mind?

o: There's more to keep track of than I thought, so it's a hassle.

chat.t: I see.
It cannot be helped. You have your own work to attend to.
Though it is a bit of a pity.

o: I'd rather just drink at your bar.

chat.t: Is that so?
I suppose that is not bad either.
Please feel free to contact me anytime again.
I will be waiting.
Because you are my special guest.

lines.t: Hideout
Excuse me.
You're early.
Yes.
I closed up a bit early today.
I also finished preparing for tomorrow's opening before coming.
So, you may ask whatever you need.
Since I owe you for the last expo, please speak freely.
Well, just take a seat over there for now.I need to get ready too.
Preparation, you say?
Are these... beverage-making tools?When did you get all this...
Perhaps from the last class...?
Since I learned it, I might as well put it to use.
And get a professional's review on it.
...I see.
I did not expect you to remember.
Let me know if you think I have a talent.
Talent, you say?
If I'm good at it, I might start a business.
Heh, so that was your real objective.
A man's gotta dream big.
...Is that so.
Excuse me for a moment.
Huh? Why are you so close—
It is more stable to hold the tool like this.
...Hmm.
(We keep brushing against each other, it's actually making it hard to focus.)
Hmm... come to think of it, this is a good opportunity in many ways.
Pardon?
It's nothing. Do I do it like this?
You seem to have a knack for this.
When pouring, tilt it at a steady angle as if locking your wrist.
That way, the ingredients will mix evenly and establish the overall texture of the drink.
When shaking, keep your elbows close to your body and maintain a steady force and rhythm.
...Did you hear that just now?
The sound of the ice in the shaker has turned slightly duller.
This is the exact moment the textures of the drink harmonize.
We are almost there. Now, it is time to pour it into the glass.
That much is a piece of cake.
Done.
Take a sip.
Being on the receiving end of a drink... feels quite strange.
Well then...
So this is your flavor.
It is peculiar.
Drinks vary wildly depending on who makes them, but...
It originally shouldn't have such an intense aroma and flavor...
I followed the recipe.
Indeed. I was watching you, after all.
So, what could have made it turn out so differently...
Heh. Well, I suppose it is fine.
It is different from what I know, but I like it in its own way.
You get sick of it if you only stick to the same thing.
...That is a valid point.
I am currently very satisfied with my role.
Serving the ladies, and treating the guests at the bar to drinks.
For that is the scenery of the daily life I have always wished for.
Once, I wished for that daily life to continue forever.
For it was the only true thing I had ever found.
So you basically just wanted to work all day, every day?
That sounds incredibly boring.
I knew you would say that.
...However, that is precisely why I am glad.
When I realized that you had stepped into my daily life at some point.
When I thought that this slightly altered scenery was not so bad.
The blurring of boundaries I once would have never tolerated...
If not for you, I certainly would not have realized it.
Perhaps it is quite similar to making a drink.
Just like how occasionally mixing in an ingredient not in the recipe isn't such a bad thing.
In other words, what I made is good enough to sell?
...Hmm.
Even so, it is still lacking to be served to guests.
Ruthless.
Heh.
Please do not be too disappointed.
The night is long, and we still have plenty of drinks left.I will do my best to assist you as well.
If you do not mind, I will make a few drinks as a demonstration.
Just watching from the side should prove useful to you.
That's some serious confidence.
I cannot bring shame to the ladies' names, after all.
A glass made in the style of Gin, the bartender of <Bloody Mary>...
I hope you will find it to your liking as well.
